name: Raffles Makati
short_description: A 5-star all-suite Raffles in Makati's CBD with 32 suites and floor-to-ceiling city views, sharing a tower with Fairmont Makati, holding a 4.8/5 ALL Rating (794 reviews).
ai_summary: Raffles Makati is a 5-star all-suite hotel at the heart of Makati's central business district, in a glass tower shared with Fairmont Makati and Raffles Residences Makati. It has 32 suites with floor-to-ceiling windows framing the Makati skyline. On the ninth floor, Mirèio is a Provençal-inspired brasserie noted by independent reviewers for its wine list and seasonal menus. The hotel holds a 4.8/5 ALL Rating from 794 reviews on its own Accor page. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.

core_facts.address: 1 Raffles Drive, Makati Avenue, 1224 Makati, Philippines
elite_benefits: Complimentary breakfast or lounge access for ALL Diamond members at participating hotels, per ALL - Accor Live Limitless program terms
